services.name: Homeschool Program
services.desc: Our Homeschool Jiu Jitsu program offers a unique blend of physical education, character development, and social connection-all in a fun, structured martial arts setting. Designed for homeschool families, this daytime class gives children ages 4+ the chance to build confidence, coordination, and community through the art of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Fundamental Techniques: Kids learn takedowns, escapes, and submissions in a safe, age-appropriate way. Fitness & Coordination: Classes include warm-ups, agility drills, and movement games to boost strength and motor skills. Bullying Prevention: We teach kids how to stay calm, set boundaries, and defend themselves

blurb: At Jiu Jitsu Tech it doesn’t matter if you’re a beginner or an experienced fighter, our classes offer a welcoming space to learn, sweat, and evolve. This is a coed, ego-free environment where mutual respect and support are key. We train hard, help each other grow, and celebrate progress-whether it’s mastering a new move or simply showing up and putting in the work.
